debate.key_bear_argument: Price trapped below all major moving averages (EMA-21/50, SMA-50/200), MACD deeply negative, zero momentum (RSI ~48, Stoch 36.77), ADX 16.1 shows no trend strength, and macro environment in crisis (VIX 374.4, recession yield curve) make this a weak technical setup with unfavorable risk/reward.
